crossRefs.note: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived…
because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains…
Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me, children of Israel?” says Yahweh. “Haven’t I brought up Israel…

parallels.note: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
